title: spatialscape examples
intro: Public spatial transcriptomics and single-cell datasets, one app per technology, each built from the scripts in the spatialscape-examples repository.

datasets.name: Whole mouse brain (Allen Brain Cell Atlas)
datasets.description: The adult mouse brain atlas of Yao et al. and Zhang et al. (2023): 4.0 million cells on 59 coronal MERFISH sections with the 500-gene panel, and all 4.0 million 10x nuclei at 32,285 genes on the atlas's whole-brain UMAP, labelled at every level of the 5,000-cluster taxonomy and the sections by CCF region. Data CC BY-NC 4.0, Allen Institute.

datasets.name: Human PBMCs, 10x Multiome (RNA + ATAC)
datasets.description: Human peripheral blood mononuclear cells profiled for gene expression and chromatin accessibility in the same nuclei (10x Genomics public dataset): the RNA and ATAC UMAPs side by side with one cell type legend, accessibility tracks per cell type in the genome panel, and gene activity, marker-set scores and the most variable peaks beside the genes.

datasets.name: Atera whole-transcriptome previews (FFPE tumours)
datasets.description: Two FFPE sections, human breast and cervical cancer, from the preview datasets 10x Genomics published with the Atera instrument: whole-transcriptome in situ (about 18,000 genes per cell), the morphology image, cell and nucleus boundaries and every transcript.

datasets.name: Human DLPFC, Visium (Maynard et al. 2021)
datasets.description: Twelve Visium sections of human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex from three donors (Maynard et al. 2021, Nature Neuroscience; the spatialLIBD package), with the manual cortical layer annotation and the H&E of each section.

datasets.name: Mouse brain, Visium CytAssist
datasets.description: One FFPE coronal section of mouse brain on Visium CytAssist (10x Genomics public dataset), with graph clusters and the H&E.

datasets.name: Mouse brain, Visium HD (8 µm bins)
datasets.description: One FFPE coronal section of mouse brain on Visium HD at 8 µm bins (10x Genomics public dataset), with graph clusters and the H&E.

datasets.name: Mouse brain, Xenium Prime 5K
datasets.description: One coronal section of fresh-frozen mouse brain on Xenium Prime 5K (10x Genomics public dataset): 5,006 genes, the morphology image, cell and nucleus boundaries and every transcript.

datasets.name: Mouse brain receptor map, MERSCOPE
datasets.description: Three coronal mouse brain slices from Vizgen's open-access MERFISH Mouse Brain Receptor Map (MERSCOPE, 483 genes): cell boundaries, every detected transcript, and the DAPI and polyT mosaics at one z plane.

datasets.name: Non-small-cell lung cancer, CosMx SMI
datasets.description: Eight FFPE lung tumour sections from the CosMx SMI paper (He et al. 2022, 960-plex RNA): the paper's cell types and niches, every transcript with its compartment, cell boundaries traced from the segmentation masks, and the per-FOV composite images stitched into one picture per section.

datasets.name: Spatial ATAC + RNA, mouse brain (Zhang et al. 2023)
datasets.description: Chromatin accessibility and gene expression in the same 20 µm pixels of mouse brain, from the spatial epigenome–transcriptome co-profiling of Zhang et al. 2023 (GEO GSE205055): two 50 x 50 arrays (1 mm) and one 100 x 100 array (2 mm). RNA on the pixels; ATAC as tracks per cluster in the genome panel.
